resources.string: Know the area. Walk with confidence.
This is an early release. The splash screen and navigation skeleton are in place. Full features will be added in future releases.
This screen will show recorded crimes for a selected UK location. Live data will be added in a future release.
Crime records in this app come from data.police.uk, the official UK Police open data service. Your identity and your exact location are never sent to any other company.
This app uses public sector information published by the UK Police. That information is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The button below opens the full licence in your browser.
The current version of SafePath UK declares only the internet permission so it can later fetch crime records over a secure HTTPS connection. No other permission is used in this release.
